# Offline Three.js viewer dependencies

Version: Three.js r128 (0.128.0), including its matching OrbitControls and GLTFLoader.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128
License: MIT; the original notice is included in `LICENSE`.

These files are served locally and shipped inside the Android APK. The viewer
does not fetch JavaScript or model textures from a CDN at runtime. This version
supports WebGL 1 and the Android 10 system WebView.
